title: Concept: Repository credential stored in a settings file
description: settings.xml declares a literal password in `settings.xml`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A secret committed in this file is readable by everyone with repository access and lives on in history after removal. This rule reads a literal password in `settings.xml`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through settings.xml (maven).
risk: A secret committed in this file is readable by everyone with repository access and lives on in history after removal. This rule reads a literal password in `settings.xml`.
